item.tib: yab sras rnam gsum thugs sgrubs rgyud las yum mchog 'od 'bar mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyud dam can spyi bskul me dpung dkyil 'khor
item.coloph: ces par mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar mas kho bo g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag la snyan du brgyud cing khyung nag pho brang du gtan la phab pa'o shin tu gnyan pas gal thod du mi bya'o//
